parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{};const now=new Date().toISOString();const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId;const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId;const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId;const classification=String(i.classification||i.ai_classification?.label||'unknown').toLowerCase();const response=String(i.seller_response||i.inbound_message||'').trim();const baseMao=Number(i.current_mao??i.mao??i.dynamic_mao??0);const ask=Number(i.seller_ask??i.counteroffer_amount??i.asking_price??0);const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact);const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[];let route='human_control',decision='review_required',factor=1,reason='insufficient_strategy_context';if(dnc){route='human_control';decision='stop';reason='dnc';}else if(blockers.length){route='human_control';decision='blocked';reason='deal_blocker';}else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId){route='reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';}else if(classification==='rejection_or_optout'){route='reengagement';decision='reengage_or_close';reason='seller_rejected';}else if(classification==='positive'){route='negotiation';decision='advance_negotiation';reason='seller_positive';}else if(classification==='counteroffer'){if(baseMao>0&&ask>0){const ratio=ask/baseMao;if(ratio<=1.05){factor=1.02;decision='evaluate_counteroffer';reason='counteroffer_near_mao';}else if(ratio<=1.15){factor=1;decision='negotiate_within_mao';reason='counteroffer_above_mao';}else{factor=.97;decision='protect_mao_or_walk';reason='counteroffer_far_above_mao';}}else{decision='request_underwriting';reason='missing_mao_or_ask';}route='negotiation';}else if(classification==='call_request'){route='negotiation';decision='schedule_or_human_call';reason='seller_requested_call';}else if(classification==='question_or_neutral'){route='negotiation';decision='clarify_and_continue';reason='neutral_response';}const adjustedMao=baseMao>0?Number((baseMao*factor).toFixed(2)):0;const key=(i.event_idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,propertyId,classification,response].filter(Boolean).join(':'))+':strategy';return[{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-364',status:'strategy_ready',route,decision,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,classification,seller_response:response,base_mao:baseMao,seller_ask:ask,mao_adjustment_factor:factor,adjusted_mao:adjustedMao,negotiation_strategy:{decision,reason,classification,base_mao:baseMao,adjusted_mao:adjustedMao,seller_ask:ask,protect_mao:true,walk_away_if_exceeded:adjustedMao>0&&ask>adjustedMao},strategy_idempotency_key:key,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'negotiation_strategy_dynamic_mao',workflow_id:'WF-364',decision,reason,classification,base_mao:baseMao,adjusted_mao:adjustedMao,seller_ask:ask}}}];
